fields.acceptance: A testscript runs ! exec rhiza tui launch and checks stderr has usage: rhiza tui app <name> and the exit code is 2
fields.statement: rhiza tui launch is no command: it exits 2 with the rhiza tui app <name> usage and opens no picker

fields.acceptance: rex-install.txtar checks the new wording and ! stdout quick-launch; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated and holds no quick-launch
fields.statement: rhiza rex install and rex uninstall describe the script as Rhiza's app actions and key mode, not a quick-launch script, in their summaries, request docs and output

set.acceptance: For each of the four commands, a testscript on a fixture model checks the app's result equals the command's --json output, and the test starts no daemon and binds no socket
set.statement: ready, show, why and slice run as apps that call the internal/api registry in-process and show the same result as the matching rhiza command --json
ready, show, why and slice run as apps and show the same result as the matching rhiza command --json
rhiza rex install writes Rhiza's app actions and key mode as a Lua script into the Rex config and reloads Rex, and a second run leaves the owner's own config untouched
